name: dify-mock-tools
description: AIエージェントカタログ UI モックと検証ツール群

scripts.ci: npm test && python3 dify/check.py && python3 scripts/dify/render.py --env cloud-master --all --check && python3 scripts/dify/tests/test_sync_back.py && python3 scripts/dify/tests/test_run_tests.py && python3 scripts/dify/tests/test_lang_check.py && python3 scripts/dify/run_tests.py --dry-run --out "$(mktemp -d)" $(awk '/^apps:/{f=1;next} f && /^[A-Za-z]/{f=0} f' dify/env/cloud-master/env.yml | grep -oE '[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
